title: Kemi got rejected
caption: Rejected from your dream scholarship? 💔 It's not the end. Ask for feedback, improve one thing, and apply again. Kemi's story will make you feel seen. Share this with someone who needs it ❤️ #scholarship #rejection #motivation #storytime

scenes.backdrop: quiet city park in light rain with wet benches, puddles and grey sky

beats.text: Quddus, I got the email. We regret to inform you. Two years of preparing, and it took them one line to say no.
beats.say: Kuddus, I got the email. We regret to inform you. Two years of preparing, and it took them one line to say no.
I'm sorry, Kemi. That really hurts. It's okay to be sad today.
Maybe people like me are not meant for these scholarships.
No. Rejection is about one application, in one year, with limited spaces. It's not about your worth.

scenes.backdrop: warm cozy café with fairy lights, plants and a rainy window

beats.say: Okay. I'm ready to try again. Where do I start?
First, ask politely if they give feedback. Then read your application with fresh eyes, or let someone you trust review it.
And maybe I applied to only one place.
Exactly. Apply to several good fits. Many winners were rejected before.
Round two. Same dream, better application!

scenes.backdrop: abstract glowing world map with flight paths, deep blue and gold, cinematic

beats.text: Share this with a friend who got a rejection email, and comment AGAIN if you're trying again.
beats.say: Share this with a friend who got a rejection email, and comment AGAIN if you're trying again.
Follow, and let's win the next one together!
